help.desc: Frequently Asked Questions, keyboard shortcuts, and system diagnostics.
help.faq_a1: Go to the 'Download' page in the left menu, paste a YouTube link, select the format (video/audio) and folder, then click 'Download'. Make sure yt-dlp is configured in System Settings if required.
help.faq_a2: The sidebar menu is built dynamically from system routes stored in the database. Administrators can edit, order, and toggle visibility of routes under System Management.
help.faq_q3: How to attach screenshots in feedback?
help.faq_a3: In the Feedback form, click 'Attach Screenshot' to select a local file or paste a direct image URL. Cloudinary must be configured to enable screenshot uploads.

text.title: Text Utilities Workbench
text.description: Case conversion, text cleaning, Vietnamese accent stripper, URL slug generator and statistics
text.sampleContent:
Hello everyone! This is the All-in-One Text Processing Workbench.
Supported features:
- Case conversion: UPPERCASE, lowercase, Sentence case, Capitalize Words.
- Code naming: camelCase, kebab-case, snake_case, CONSTANT_CASE.
- Remove accents & generate SEO-friendly URL slugs.
- Clean extra whitespace, filter empty lines, sort lines A-Z.
- Encode & decode Base64, URL Encoding, HTML Entities.
